usage: 通知 (tung1 zi1) is used as a noun to mean a notification or an alert.
It often refers to messages you receive on your phone or device about updates or new information.
You use 通知 in sentences to talk about receiving or checking notifications.
It can refer to both digital notifications and formal announcements.
The word 通知 can be combined with verbs like 收到 (to receive) or 關閉 (to turn off) to describe actions related to notifications.
